name: Aesthetic Expectation Violation Circuit
short_description: Detects violations of aesthetic schemas based on expertise level, generating surprise and interest signals that modulate aesthetic engagement.

components.name: AESTHETIC_SCHEMA
components.description: Maintains learned aesthetic prototypes and stylistic expectations based on expertise

components.name: VIOLATION_DETECTOR
components.description: Detects deviation of actual stimulus from aesthetic prototype

components.name: EXPERTISE_MODULATOR
components.description: Adjusts violation detection threshold based on observer expertise

components.name: INTEREST_GENERATOR
components.description: Translates aesthetic violation into interest and arousal signal

key_references: Van de Cruys, S., & Wagemans, J. (2011). Putting reward in art: A tentative prediction error account of visual art. i-Perception, 2(9), 1035–1062.
Berlyne, D. E. (1971). Aesthetics and Psychobiology. Appleton-Century-Crofts.
design_implications: Moderate aesthetic violations that match expertise level optimize interest; novices benefit from clear stylistic coherence, while experts seek novel combinations
Art and design installations should scaffold aesthetic expectations before introducing violations; contextualize novel elements to engage rather than alienate
